name.la: Vita secunda sancti Francisci (Memoriale in desiderio animae)
name.en-US: The Second Life of St. Francis (Vita secunda)
name.pt-BR: Segunda Vida de São Francisco (Vita secunda)

description.la: Thomae de Celano Vita secunda sancti Francisci, seu Memoriale in desiderio animae (1246-1247), iussu ministri generalis Crescentii de Esi ex testimoniis sociorum composita: prologus et duo opera (res gestae; virtutes et dicta sancti), cum paragraphis numeratis.
description.en-US: Thomas of Celano’s Second Life of St. Francis, the Memorial in the Desire of the Soul (1246-1247), written for the minister general Crescentius of Jesi from the testimony of Francis’s companions: a prologue and two books, the second a topical anthology of his virtues and sayings. Latin, with paragraph and verse numbers; the source’s rubrics stand as headings.
description.pt-BR: A Segunda Vida de São Francisco, ou Memorial no desejo da alma, por Tomás de Celano (1246-1247), composta a partir dos testemunhos dos companheiros do santo.

la.editor: transcription of the critical text of Fontes Franciscani (1995) by M. Mastrorilli, Politecnico di Bari; edition not stated

sources.edition: Thomas of Celano, Vita secunda, poliba.it "Fonti francescane" (Wayback Machine snapshot).
sources.description: Prologue, first book (19 chapters) and second book. The sub-rubrics of the second book (heading-only entries in the source) stand as ## headings at the top of the next chapter. English (Howell 1908) is OCR only, not imported.
sources.tierEvidence: Medieval text. The transcription (M. Mastrorilli, Politecnico di Bari, Biblioteca di Scienze del Cristianesimo, 2000-02) survives only in the Wayback Machine; it states no edition, but its biblical apparatus follows Fontes Franciscani (1995). Free in practice, edition unverified.
